title: A to-do list renderer
description:
Build the HTML for a to-do list from its data, safely. ``` render([{ text: "Buy ", done: false }, { text: "Walk", done: true }]) ->
  • Buy <milk>
  • Walk

1 of 2 done

```
hints: `todos.map(t => ...).join("")` builds the items; `todos.filter(t => t.done).length` counts the finished ones.
Replacing `&` last would turn `<` into `&lt;`: that is why it goes first.
requirements:
`render(todos)` returns the list and the count line; an empty list gives `

Nothing to do

`.
In a page, the result would be set with `list.innerHTML = render(todos)`.
stretch: Write the browser part too: an `<input>` and a button that add a to-do and render again.
